name: erpnext
summary: Open-source ERP platform for finance, operations, inventory, CRM, and internal process automation.
why_it_matters: ERP capability may matter for future business-system scenarios, but the previous registry-only record was not a maintained or validated Vrooli resource.
when_to_use: A scenario needs a serious ERP backbone for inventory, finance, or operations workflows.
An enterprise deployment needs open-source ERP integration as part of a larger system.

platform_support.notes: ERPNext usually runs as a multi-service stack and should only be supported if Vrooli wants to own its operational complexity.

prerequisites: A validated scenario with real ERP requirements
Operational willingness to manage a multi-service business system
implementation_notes: Promotion should start from a compose-style deployment with honest operational expectations.
Do not revive the old registry entry as if it represented a supported integration.
Future support should define upgrade, backup, and tenant boundaries.
operational_notes: Business-system upgrades and data migrations are the hard part of support.
Validation must include more than process startup; operator workflows need to work.
risks: ERP stacks are expensive to support relative to speculative value.
Half-supported ERP integrations create trust problems quickly.
